_comment: Buildertrend Schedule items marked complete from county evidence (approved by Victor, 2026-10-19). An item is marked complete only when the evidence exists: a PASSED county inspection matching 'inspection' (regex on the inspection type), the permit issued ('permit_issued'), or the CO recorded ('co'). Never un-marks, never changes dates, never touches items without a rule here (Windows, Doors, Stucco, Drywall, Shingles, Finishes, Painting, Cabinetry, Appliances, Irrigation, Landscaping, Final Cleaning, the draws). 'item' is a regex on the schedule item title (titles are the PKB template, typos included).
